_comment: Member registry for the vLLM VRAM-swap (memswap) coordinator.
Each member is one long-lived vLLM engine on the single Arc B70 (32 GB); only
ONE may be awake at a time. Edited by hand; read by scripts/vllm-memswapd.py.
'compose' is relative to the repo root. 'aliases' are extra request names that
resolve to this member. 'sticky_names' resolve to whatever is currently awake
(falling back to default_model) so a generic client group cannot thrash the card.
_retired_note: 2026-10-02: the sleep-mode pair was retired and its containers moved to
along with the rest of the GPTQ-Int4 qwen3.8 family (-mult, -single,
-bigcontext, -native) and vllm-qwen38-heretic. Their members were removed
from this registry -- they named compose paths that no longer exist, and
compose() only logs 'compose file missing' before failing.
The legacy request names (qwen3.8, qwen3.8-65k, qwen3.8-96k, qwen3.8-131k)
still reach the card: LiteLLM resolves them to openai//model @ :8000, which
is whatever owns the port -- today the boot-enabled EXL3 engine below.
What remains is a single SLEEP-LESS member, so the coordinator can only
report and stay passive (see _sleep_less); the card is owned by
_idle_sleep_note: 0 = the idle-release is DISABLED. vllm-memswapd.py:489 reads
`if self.idle_sleep_seconds > 0 and idle_for > self.idle_sleep_seconds`, so a
non-positive value makes the coordinator never park the card on idleness.
The coordinator is the only thing that calls /sleep; engines were parked
by an explicit `scripts/vllm-memswap.sh` operation (that path is retired
with the pair: nothing here is sleep-capable any more).
_autostart_members_note: false = the coordinator never starts a member on its own, it only releases
an idle card and detects split-brain. Historically this was required while
vllm-qwen3.8-mult owned :8000 and auto-starting its pair member would have
crash-looped on the bind. Both of those are retired; keep this false so the
coordinator cannot fight the boot-enabled vllm-qwen38-exl3 unit for the card.

members.name: qwen3.8-exl3
members._note: Sole owner of the :8000 slot: turboderp/Qwen3.8-27B-exl3 (EXL3 trellis 4.00 bpw) served by the exl3xpu engine. Start or restart it with the unit, not with a swap: `systemctl --user stop vllm-memswap; systemctl --user restart vllm-qwen38-exl3; systemctl --user start vllm-memswap`.
_sleep_less: This is a SLEEP-LESS member on purpose: the exl3xpu engine does not take
--enable-sleep-mode, and this container deliberately does NOT set
VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE (that would mount POST /sleep, and POSTing /sleep at a
sleep-less engine hangs its core -- the API keeps answering GETs while
completions never run). Consequence: /is_sleeping is absent, so the
coordinator reports this member as 'running, sleep state unreadable' and
stays passive for that tick instead of guessing who owns the card.
container_sleep_capable() in scripts/vllm-memswapd.py exists for this
case and refuses to /sleep it. Do NOT enable MEMSWAP_ENABLED=true in the
litellm compose while this member is the awake owner: the pre-call hook
